messages.content: Write a short explanation of how gravity works, but do not use the letter 'e' at all.
Mass draws mass. Throw a ball up; it falls down. Why? Our world tugs it. Big bulk pulls small things. Suns grip orbiting worlds. This pull is physics at work.
